none: PAS CAM-5DC652: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy, possibly a contemporary copy, of a nummus of Constantine II or Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy, possibly a contemporary copy, of a nummus of Constantine II or Constantius II. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]NOB C. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.9g, diameter is 16mm
